Ha, well you've got a solid foundation for a pretty big life change — that's worth a late night. Get some rest!

When you're ready to pick back up, we still have a few things to finish from your original list: the room-by-room packing checklist with declutter tips, the services and subscriptions cancellation timeline, the 6–8 week phone calendar, and the printable moving day one-pager. They'll be here whenever you want them.
